stations.title: The terminal
stations.text: Forgets every setting when it closes.
stations.note: Sol's tool is not found either.

stations.title: Idris
stations.say: Every label knows who sent it.

captions: At Ashgrove, Idris finds the sender line of the parcel label empty again this morning.
The terminal forgets every setting when it closes, and Sol's tool cannot be found.
You set variables, pass them on and keep them in a settings file, in four small tasks.
Loaded in any new shell, the settings name the sender and find Sol's tool.
Idris opens a terminal, and the shop's settings are there every morning.
